posts.title: Fleischer Friday at Way Too Damn Lazy To Write A Blog
posts.description: Now, let's enjoy some quality time watching cartoons produced by the Fleischer studio! Arguably, this blog's favorite animated cartoon produced by the studio where all the Fleischer animators ended up after Max and Dave got the boot, Famous Studios, with honorable mentions to the excellent musical WE’RE ON OUR WAY TO RIO (1944) and the hilarious SHAPE AHOY (1945), remains Popeye in THE HUNGRY GOAT
